rows.grounds: Compound analyzable as bhū-bhū-bhūḥ-rāma-veda-akṣi-mantra-arṇa-aṅga-kalpanam; rāma/veda/akṣi function as numeric or symbolic indicators and mantra-arṇa as mantra-syllables used for aṅga-kalpanam (limb assignment) in Śrīvidyā ritual context (Merutantra, M00195). Segmentation and exact referents uncertain without passage prose.
